entities.summary: David Zaslav is an American media executive who is the current CEO and president of Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD). Zaslav became CEO and president of Discovery, Inc. in 2006, and oversaw the company as it went public in 2008 and then merged with WarnerMedia in April 2022.
